$comment: Recorded-mock fixture for the camara-gsma adapter (TelecomPort P13). Adapted from ../../../../fixtures/camara-gsma/population-density.json (the repo's recorded CAMARA/GSMA fixture) and reshaped into a flat per-cell row list so the ACL can map each row 1:1 to a canonical TelecomCoverage. AGGREGATE-ONLY, synthetic demo data — no PII, no individual device/location tracking (Constitution Art. XIV; ADR-021). Every row carries aggregateOnly:true, which the ACL treats as a structural privacy invariant (a row with aggregateOnly!=true is rejected as PARSE, never silently passed through). Served when SOURCE_CAMARA_GSMA_MODE=mock (the demo default and the offline/air-gapped acceptance test).

provenance.license: Synthetic demo fixture (no upstream data; CAMARA API definitions are Apache-2.0)
provenance.attribution: Synthetic / aggregate-only. Not derived from any real subscriber data.
provenance.privacyNote: Aggregate-only by construction; no individual location, identity, or device is represented (Art. XIV; CAMARA min-aggregation / no-PII profile).
